title: Historical Background
bullets: 2020s: NIST competition and real hardware scaling
story: The race between the lock-makers and the lock-breakers.

title: The Migration Challenges
bullets: Bandwidth: PQC keys are significantly larger
Performance: Computation overhead of lattice math
story: Changing the engine of an airplane while it's in flight.
enterpriseInsight: Crypto-Agility is the only long-term solution.
